---mode: agentdescription: Batch 05. Import one CSV, edit mappings, and review rows into spends, income, or skips. About 60K tokens.---
Build batch 05 only.
Read: `src/adapters/csv-mapping.ts`, `src/adapters/file-ledger.ts`, `src/domain/ledger.ts`, `src/ui/LocalApp.tsx`, `src/ui/views/SpendForm.tsx`, `src/ui/views/ActivityView.tsx`.Create: `src/ui/views/ImportView.tsx`, `src/ui/views/MappingEditor.tsx`, `src/ui/views/ReviewView.tsx`.
## Build
1. `ImportView`, one file at a time.   - Pick the account. Use its saved mapping, or pick a suggested preset, or open `MappingEditor`. Save the choice on the account.   - Show a preview of the first 20 rows and every row error. Commit is blocked while errors remain.   - SHA-256 of the file text with `crypto.subtle`. The same hash on the same account does nothing and says so.   - Use `findNewRows`. If some rows already exist, ask once for the file: "Skip N existing rows" or "Add them anyway".   - Checkbox "Older history: keep out of balances", off by default. Store it on the import.   - Commit adds the import and its new rows. Show the count added.2. `MappingEditor`: name, date format, header toggle, then a select for each field. The options come from the file's first row, as header names or Column 1, 2, and so on. Save as a new mapping and set it on the account.3. `ReviewView`: rows with no `entryId`, no `settlementId`, and not skipped. Newest first. Show the count in the nav with `nav-count`.   - Negative row, Spend: open `SpendForm` with the date, description, amount (absolute), account, and payer set from the account. The default portion is the whole amount to the account's payer. On save, the entry gets `bankRowIds: [row.id]` and `countsTowardDebt` from the import. The row gets `entryId`.   - Positive row, Income: an income entry with no portions.   - Any row, Skip: set `skipped`.   - Transfer, Settlement, and Refund come in later batches. Do not show them.   - After an action, focus moves to the next row.4. `ActivityView`: an entry with `bankRowIds` shows the bank date, description, and amount beneath it. Deleting that entry clears the row's `entryId`.
## Tests
None. `findNewRows` is already tested.
## Done when
`npm run typecheck` passes. In the page: import a synthetic ING file, classify one row as a spend and one as a skip, reimport the same file, and nothing is added. Update `PROGRESS.md`. Next is 06.
